title: CMOS 影像感測器製作
summary: 從像素訊號鏈、完整電荷轉移到感測器驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pixel signal chain and Complete charge transfer to Sensor acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 像素訊號鏈 → 光二極體深度
stages.titleEn: Pixel signal chain to Photodiode depth
stages.description: 把「像素訊號鏈」「前照與背照」「光二極體深度」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Pixel signal chain, Front versus back illumination, Photodiode depth.

steps.title: 像素訊號鏈：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Pixel signal chain: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies.
steps.instruction: 畫光子、光電荷、轉移閘、浮接擴散與讀出放大器。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw photons, photocharge, transfer gate, floating diffusion and amplifier. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率；轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷。
steps.observationEn: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies; Transfer timing affects readable charge.
steps.failure: 若採用「把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「像素訊號鏈」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Pixel signal chain diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies.

knowledge.title: 像素訊號鏈／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Pixel signal chain / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies.

knowledge.title: 像素訊號鏈／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Pixel signal chain / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain.

quiz.question: 關於「像素訊號鏈」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Pixel signal chain, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率
把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標
背照就自動消除暗電流與串擾
optionsEn: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies
Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain
Assuming backside illumination eliminates dark current and crosstalk
quiz.explanation: 光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 像素訊號鏈：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pixel signal chain: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「像素訊號鏈」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Pixel signal chain artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Transfer timing affects readable charge. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率；轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷。
steps.observationEn: Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies; Transfer timing affects readable charge.
steps.failure: 若採用「把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「像素訊號鏈」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Pixel signal chain, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Transfer timing affects readable charge" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 像素訊號鏈／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Pixel signal chain / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：轉移閘時序會影響可讀出的電荷。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Transfer timing affects readable charge.

knowledge.title: 像素訊號鏈／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Pixel signal chain / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把量子效率和電壓增益當同一指標」與「光學收集與電性讀出是不同效率」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Equating quantum efficiency with voltage gain" is not equivalent to "Optical collection and electrical readout have different efficiencies"; the control must expose their difference.
